_comment: The Blitz Strike orchestration framework. The driving LLM loads this at engagement start and follows the lifecycle phase by phase, fanning out the team in parallel where phases are independent.

lifecycle.name: Scope & gate
lifecycle.goal: confirm target, scope, and authorization before touching anything
lifecycle.exit: target classified (URL vs source), scope_check passed

lifecycle.name: Recon (BLITZ)
lifecycle.goal: map the full attack surface — entry points, sinks, framework, tech
lifecycle.exit: entry points + sinks + framework enumerated (no surface left unmapped)

lifecycle.name: Analyze (EAGLE-EYE)
lifecycle.goal: trace source→sink reachability for every candidate sink
lifecycle.exit: each sink classified reachable / unreachable / sanitized, with a source→sink trace

lifecycle.name: Deep (complex bugs)
lifecycle.goal: hunt complex-bug classes breadth detectors miss
lifecycle.exit: POP chains, type juggling, mass assignment, route confusion candidates enumerated + linked to escalation chains

lifecycle.name: Verify (STRIKE)
lifecycle.goal: confirm each hypothesis live with deterministic evidence
lifecycle.exit: every hypothesis confirmed or rejected (marker + negative control)

lifecycle.name: Report
lifecycle.exit: report emitted (markdown/JSON/SARIF) with SHA-256 integrity hash

team.name: Recon agent (BLITZ tier)
team.returns: enumerated entry points + sinks + framework/tech, each with file:line or URL

team.name: Taint agent (EAGLE-EYE tier)
team.returns: reachable sinks with a source→sink trace and a reachability verdict

team.name: Deep agent (complex bugs)
team.returns: POP chain / type juggling / mass assignment / route confusion candidates, linked to escalation chains

team.name: Verify agent (STRIKE tier)
team.returns: confirmed or rejected findings, each with marker + negative control + evidence

delegate_contract: the exact tool names to use
the exact argument names (source-analysis tools take `path`, only `run_engagement` takes `target`)
what deterministic output is required back
result_contract: deterministic evidence (file:line, sink, trace, marker reflection) — never prose
a verdict per finding: confirmed / hypothesis / rejected
no fabricated results — empty is reported as empty, not filled in

done_when: every reachable sink has been traced
every hypothesis is confirmed or rejected
findings are deduplicated and the report is emitted
not_done_when: a scan surfaced few sinks but the target surface is wider
a low-severity finding has not been checked for escalation (chain_links)
